--- Email Out ---
Subject: Group Project Meeting Summary

Hi everyone,

Thanks for joining today’s meeting. I’ll compile our discussion notes and the action items for next week’s deliverables. If anyone has updates to the timeline, please let me know.

Best,
Samantha

--- Email In ---
Subject: Group Project Notes Attached

Hey team,

Here’s the meeting summary from today, including assigned roles, next steps, and draft outline for our presentation. Feel free to suggest edits before we finalize by Thursday.

Regards,
Jacob

--- Attachment ---
CS305 Group Project Meeting Notes – Week 4

Date: June 11, 2024  
Attendees: Samantha (Team Lead), Jacob, Priya, Alex, Minh  
Absent: None

Meeting Duration: 1 hour (3:00 PM – 4:00 PM)

---

I. Agenda Recap

- Review progress on research and deliverables
- Assign roles for next week’s tasks
- Draft outline for presentation
- Discuss timeline updates
